gloss: life-threatening; to be a matter of life and death

definitions.gloss: life-threatening; to be a matter of life and death
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation, condition, or action that could result in death. Used to emphasize the extreme seriousness of a danger.

examples.japanese: {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{危険|きけん}がある。
{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}は{命|いのち}に{関|かか}わることもある。
{放置|ほうち}すれば{命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{病気|びょうき}なので、すぐに{治療|ちりょう}を{始|はじ}めてください。
examples.english: It is an illness that can be fatal if left untreated, so please begin treatment immediately.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as a verb phrase. Can modify nouns with the plain form: {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{問題|もんだい} (a life-threatening issue). The verb {関|かか}わる conjugates as a godan verb.
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる + noun (a life-threatening ~)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わることもある (it can even be life-threatening)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{事故|じこ} (a life-threatening accident)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{病気|びょうき} (a life-threatening illness)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{問題|もんだい} (a matter of life and death)
